title: Understanding Correlation
text: The correlation matrix shows how strongly two variables are related. A correlation of $$1$$ or $$-1$$ indicates a perfect linear relationship, while a correlation of $$0$$ indicates no linear relationship. Consider how these correlations might affect the model's ability to predict $$self_{rating}$$.

title: Correlation and Model Uniqueness
text: Think about how the correlation between the predictors (critic_1 and critic_2) and the response $$self_{rating}$$ might influence the uniqueness of the model solution. High correlation between predictors can lead to multicollinearity, affecting the model's stability.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Consider the number of data points needed to determine a unique solution for a linear model. Is it true that at least $$2$$ distinct data points are necessary?
